EN: Did you say, “slavers”?
ZH: 你刚才是说，“奴隶贩子”？

EN: Surrender! You stepped into our trap.
ZH: 投降吧！你们踏进了我们的陷阱。

EN: After taking that "miracle cure", you followed the smarmy salesman here...
ZH: 服下那瓶“神药”之后，你们一路跟着那个油嘴滑舌的推销员来到了这里……

EN: But now you're weak from the serum, so we can sell you into slavery! Mwahahaha!
ZH: 可如今血清让你们浑身乏力，我们正好能把你们卖去当奴隶！哇哈哈！

EN: My guilty conscience will quiet down once I get paid... right?
ZH: 只要拿到钱，我那点良心就会安静下来……对吧？

EN: You don't want to be a slave? But you already are! How awful!
ZH: 你不想当奴隶？但你已经是了！太糟糕了！

EN: Stop changing the subject! Are you even listening?!
ZH: 别转移话题！你有在听我说话吗？！

EN: Don't be insensitive!
ZH: 别这么无情！

EN: Nope, nope, nope. Nope!
ZH: 不行，不行，不行。不行！

EN: Did you make the “miracle serum”? I have a complaint.
ZH: 那瓶“奇迹血清”是你们做的？我有投诉要提。

EN: Who cares? You'll be dead soon anyway.
ZH: 谁在乎呢？反正你们马上要死了。

EN: Oh, hello! You… got past the slavers. I mean, the guards. That's great! Good for you!
ZH: 哦，你好！你……通过了那些奴隶商。我是说，警卫。太好了！为你骄傲！

EN: Look, they made me do it! Just let me go and I'll be good!
ZH: 听着，是他们逼我的！放过我，我以后会老实的！

EN: I don't know where they are, we made the serum in a slapshod lab in Westside. Bye!
ZH: 我不知道他们在哪里，我们是在西区一个拼凑的实验室里做血清的。再见！

EN: You can go if you tell me where they are.
ZH: 你说出他们在哪里，我就放你走。

EN: Um, you're like, official looking. Are you the manager?
ZH: 嗯……你看起来挺有管事的架势。你是这里的经理吗？

EN: This place is in such bad taste. The clothes are disgusting.
ZH: 这地方品味真差。那些衣服恶心死了。

EN: And one of your employees tried to sell me into slavery! Well, I told him off. Jerk.
ZH: 而且你们有个员工还想把我卖去当奴隶！不过我已经骂了他一顿。混账。

EN: I'll... well, I... I'm not coming back!
ZH: 我……好吧，我……我不会再来了！

EN: Thank you. Here, take this. It's the best thing I found in this dump.
ZH: 谢谢你。给，拿着这个。这是我在这个破地方找到的最好东西。

EN: Ugh, fine. Then I'm out of here! After I look in one more room. I love shopping.
ZH: 呃，好吧。那我走啦！不过临走前我再逛一间房。我爱逛街。

EN: So what if I am the manager?
ZH: 就算我是经理又怎样？

EN: No, but I'll tell them what you said.
ZH: 不是。但我会把你刚才说的话告诉他们的。

EN: I'm just an employee. Are you going to pay for that?
ZH: 我只是个员工。你打算为那东西付钱吗？

EN: Protect the serum!
ZH: 保护血清！

EN: This was supposed to be a quiet shift!
ZH: 本来是个安静的班次的！

EN: The Snake Oil Salesman sent us to a rickety building in the so-called Westside of New Vegas. They won't be making any more “Miracle Serum” when we're done with them.
ZH: 那个卖蛇油的把我们派到新维加斯所谓“西区”的一栋摇摇欲坠的楼里。等我们收拾完他们，他们就再也造不出“奇迹血清”了。

EN: Crime Lab
ZH: 犯罪实验室

EN: Destroy the lab
ZH: 摧毁那个实验室。

EN: Find out where the slavers are
ZH: 查明奴隶贩子的位置。

EN: Stop the production of “Miracle Serum” in Westside.
ZH: 阻止西区“奇迹血清”的生产。

EN: Hey, who are you?
ZH: 嘿，你是谁？

EN: Oh. Huh. Okay… Go ahead then.
ZH: 哦。好吧……进去吧。

EN: No way! I'll lose my job!
ZH: 不行！我会丢工作的！

EN: No way! That place is off limits!
ZH: 不行！那里是禁区！

EN: We're here from headquarters to inspect the lab.
ZH: 我们是从总部来检查实验室的。

EN: We're here to destroy the serum lab.
ZH: 我们是来销毁血清实验室的。

EN: Just passing through. Hoping to take a walk… upstairs…
ZH: 就是路过。想去楼上……散散步……

EN: Huh? What's going on here? You're not the usual guards!
ZH: 嗯？这里发生什么了？你们不是平时的警卫！

EN: I don't know where they are! Seriously, I'm just an apprentice! Please don't shoot!
ZH: 我不知道他们在哪里！我真的只是个学徒！请不要开枪！

EN: Tell us where the slavers are and you can live.
ZH: 告诉我们奴隶商在哪里，你就可以活着。

EN: You're here to destroy our operation. I can see that… I won't stop you. In fact, I'll tell you where they are.
ZH: 你们是来破坏我们生意的。我看得出来……我不会阻止你们。事实上，我告诉你们他们在哪里。

EN: They're at an abandoned vault in a valley West of here. But you'll have to kill me to get to them!
ZH: 他们在西面一条山谷里的废弃避难所里。但你们要杀我，才能到达那里！

EN: You can't kill my boss. And then he'll kill me. So I'd rather just die now!
ZH: 你杀不了我老板的。然后他会杀了我。所以不如让我现在就死！

EN: As you wish!
ZH: 如你所愿！

EN: We just want to kill your boss.
ZH: 我们只是想杀你老板。

EN: Looks like this is where they've been making the serum.
ZH: 这就是他们生产血清的地方。

EN: No more poison!
ZH: 不再有毒药了！

EN: A little poison for the road?
ZH: 路上要一点毒药？

EN: <Destroy it>
ZH: <销毁>

EN: <Take some serum, then destroy it>
ZH: <取一点血清，然后销毁>

EN: Hey, am I true to my word, or what? Didn't I say I'd help you out?
ZH: 嘿，我说话算不算数？我说过会帮你们的忙吧？

EN: This is the lab where those slavers are making that fake Serum I sold you.
ZH: 这就是那些奴隶贩子制造我卖给你的假血清的实验室。

EN: I'm in real danger for helping you, though. Could you put me up in your vault? Pretty please?
ZH: 帮了你们之后我现在处境极度危险。能不能让我在你们的避难所里借住借住？求求你们啦！

EN: Oh! Vault folk really are the kindest around.
ZH: 哦！避难所居民真是世上最善良的人。

EN: Oh, of course! I'll even bring them an antidote!
ZH: 哦，当然！我还会给他们带解药！

EN: No, but isn't choice just an illusion anyway?
ZH: 不行，但所谓选择不就只是一种幻觉吗？

EN: Yeah, yeah, you can stay with us.
ZH: 好吧好吧，你可以跟我们住。

EN: You better apologize when you get there.
ZH: 你最好一到那就向他们道歉。

EN: Do I have a choice?
ZH: 我有得选吗？

EN: We've discovered the base of the raiders who have been enslaving hapless folks in Freeside, in a vault near New Vegas. But where are the slaves going?
ZH: 我们在新维加斯附近的一座避难所里，发现了在自由城奴役倒霉路人的掠夺者据点。但这批奴隶究竟被运往何方了？

EN: Casting the Die
ZH: 孤注一掷

EN: Confront the slavers' leader
ZH: 与奴隶贩子头目对峙

EN: Rescue slaves (1/2)
ZH: 拯救奴隶（1/2）

EN: Rescue slaves (2/2)
ZH: 拯救奴隶（2/2）

EN: Confront the slavers at their base near New Vegas.
ZH: 前往新维加斯附近奴隶贩子的基地，与他们对峙。

EN: Hm, never seen you before. What's the password?
ZH: 嗯，从没见过你。口令是什么？

EN: That's it! Go on in.
ZH: 对了！进去吧。

EN: Nope! That's not it! Intruders!
ZH: 不对！不是这个！有入侵者！

EN: Die, slaver scum!
ZH: 去死吧，奴隶贩子人渣！

EN: Um, rainbows and lollipops?
ZH: 呃，彩虹和棒棒糖？

EN: All that shooting, was that you? Are you here to save me?
ZH: 外面那阵枪声，是你们开的？你们是来救我的吗？

EN: Oh, heck yeah!
ZH: 太棒啦，那敢情好！

EN: Yeah! Come live in our vault!
ZH: 对！来我们避难所住吧！

EN: Huh? What's going on?
ZH: 啊？怎么了？

EN: I guess so. I'm good anywhere, really.
ZH: 我想是吧。我去哪儿都行，真的。

EN: You're free. Why not come live in our vault?
ZH: 你自由了。不如来我们避难所住？

EN: What are you doing here?! Don't you know who we are? We're working with the dang Legion!
ZH: 你们在这儿干什么？！你们不知道我们是谁吗？我们可是在为该死的军团干活！

EN: Leave them alive! They'll be good slaves when they recover.
ZH: 留他们一命！等他们恢复了，会是不错的奴隶。

EN: What?! Do you live in a vault or something?!
ZH: 什么？！你们难道是住在避难所之类的吗？！

EN: They sure as hell scare me!
ZH: 他们可把我吓得不轻！

EN: You're slavers. That's enough for me!
ZH: 你们是奴隶贩子。这就够我动手了！

EN: Legion? Never heard of them.
ZH: 军团？从没听说过。

EN: The Legion doesn't scare us.
ZH: 军团吓不到我们。

EN: You smell like vault dwellers. But some of those losers you killed were pretty strong.
ZH: 你身上一股避难所居民的味儿。不过你干掉的那几个窝囊废倒是挺强的。

EN: Don't think you're safe just because you won this round.
ZH: 别以为赢了这一局你们就安全了。

EN: Caesar's wrath will destroy you and everything you love!
ZH: 凯撒的怒火会摧毁你们和你们所爱的一切！

EN: Indeed… but not now. Later.
ZH: 确实……但不是现在。以后再说。

EN: Not a chance. I'm too important to die!
ZH: 门都没有。我太重要了，不能死！

EN: You must be joking. Inferior beings are meant to serve the strong. You'll see… some day…
ZH: 你准是在开玩笑。劣等生物生来就该侍奉强者。你们会明白的……总有一天……

EN: We'll see about that.
ZH: 那咱们走着瞧。

EN: Our wrath will destroy you now!
ZH: 我们的怒火现在就摧毁你们！

EN: Can you just stop with the slave stuff?
ZH: 你能别老惦记那些奴隶的事了吗？

EN: Going to Town
ZH: 进城去

EN: Not quite the response I was looking for.
ZH: 这可不太是我想要的回应。

EN: Nice. But we're still going to kill you.
ZH: 好的。但我们还是要杀了你。

EN: Okay, right after we're done with you.
ZH: 好吧，在我们结束你之后。

EN: Hey there, good lookin'...
ZH: 嘿，美女……

EN: Hey?
ZH: 嘿？

EN: Hey yourself, beautiful.
ZH: 嘿，美人儿。

EN: Repent your sinful ways!
ZH: 忏悔你们的罪恶！

EN: Groom? Oh, you mean slave-boy? Yeah, he's ours now.
ZH: 新郎？哦，你是说奴隶男孩？是的，他现在是我们的了。

EN: Aww, that's so cute I almost feel like letting you live. Almost.
ZH: 啊，这么可爱，我几乎想让你活着了。几乎。

EN: Come on ladies, let's show these losers what we're made of!
ZH: 来吧，女士们，让我们向这些失败者展示下我们是什么做的！

EN: Welcome Dwellers.
ZH: 欢迎居民。

EN: If you're looking for adventure, you've come to the right place.
ZH: 如果你正在寻找冒险，你来到了正确的地方。

EN: We have a special clearance sale on Christmas-related stuff.
ZH: 我们在圣诞相关商品上清仓大甩卖。

EN: We came for the groom you kidnapped.
ZH: 我们是为被你们绑架的新郎而来的。

EN: True love conquers all.
ZH: 真爱征服一切。

EN: Die!
ZH: 去死吧！

EN: It has? All right, time to face the music, I guess.
ZH: 已经结束了？好吧，我想该面对现实了。

EN: I thought that was the whole point...
ZH: 我想那就是全部的关键……

EN: Oh, right. I almost forgot about that.
ZH: 哦，对。我差点忘了。

EN: You guys think I should grow a mustache?
ZH: 你们认为我应该留胡子吗？

EN: Hey guys, there you are!
ZH: 嘿，伙计们，你们在那里！

EN: I was wondering where you'd gone to.
ZH: 我想知道你去了哪里。

EN: Isn't this bachelor party the best?
ZH: 这个单身派对难道不是最好的吗？

EN: The party's been over for days...
ZH: 聚会已经结束了好几天了……

EN: You were kidnapped!
ZH: 你被绑架了！

EN: It sure is... But we gotta go get you married now.
ZH: 它肯定是……不过我们现在得送你去结婚了。

EN: Come on, let's get you home.
ZH: 来吧，我们带你回家。

EN: That was quite the bachelor party last night! Too bad the groom's missing today. Last we saw, he was being carried away by the hired entertainment. We have to bring him back, and quick. Let's avoid a repeat of New Year's Eve...
ZH: 昨晚的单身派对真不错！可惜今天新郎失踪了。最后一次看到他，已经被雇来娱乐的人拖走了。我们必须尽快把他带回来。让我们避免重蹈新年夜的覆辙……

EN: Groom for Doubt
ZH: 新郎的疑惑

EN: Rescue the groom.
ZH: 拯救新郎。

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Rescue a missing groom from Raiders.
ZH: 从掠夺者手中拯救失踪的新郎。

EN: Take groom, meet doom.
ZH: 带走新郎，迎接厄运。

EN: A rose by any other name would smell as sweet...if roses still existed.
ZH: 玫瑰换个名字照样芬芳……如果这世上还有玫瑰的话。

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Guardian of the Wastes: Deathclaws!
ZH: 废土守卫者：死爪！

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.
ZH: 杀死领头死爪。

EN: Exterminate the Deathclaws.
ZH: 剿灭死爪。

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Guardian of the Wastes: Feral Ghouls!
ZH: 废土守卫者：狂尸鬼！

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
ZH: 杀死发光种。

EN: Show the Feral Ghouls no mercy.
ZH: 对狂尸鬼绝不心慈手软。

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Guardian of the Wastes: Mole Rats!
ZH: 废土守卫者：鼹鼠！

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
ZH: 杀死鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Get rid of those pesky Mole rats.
ZH: 除掉这些可恶的鼹鼠。

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Guardian of the Wastes: Radroaches!
ZH: 废土守卫者：辐射蟑螂！

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach.
ZH: 杀死发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Clear out the nest of Radroaches.
ZH: 清理辐射蟑螂窝。

EN: Let's do our part to protect the Wasteland by clearing out a nearby nest of dangerous, irradiated creatures!
ZH: 让我们为保卫废土尽一份力。清理掉那一窝危险的，被辐射过的生物吧！

EN: Guardian of the Wastes: Radscorpions!
ZH: 废土守卫者：辐射蝎！

EN: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion.
ZH: 杀死发光辐射蝎。

EN: Eradicate the Radscorpions.
ZH: 根除辐射蝎。

EN: Our brahmin drank it all. Who can say no to golden dung? Try the abandoned Vault-Tec offices.
ZH: 我们的双头牛一饮而尽。谁能对金色的粪便说不？去废弃的避难所科技办公室试试看吧。

EN: Is the Wizard's Wonder Water really so wondrous? We didn't get enough to test it scientifically.
ZH: 水之术士的“神奇水”真有那么神奇吗？我们没弄到足够的量来做科学测试。

EN: I drank it, it tasted delicious and pure but nothing happened to me.
ZH: 我喝了，它尝起来美味而纯净，但没有什么发生在我身上。

EN: Our brahmin got into it, and two days later he pooped out a gold bar!
ZH: 我们的双头牛喝了，两天之后他拉出了金条！

EN: Our schoolmarm Mrs. Fieldstone had some, and saw a giant Nuka-Cola bottle chasing after her.
ZH: 我们的女教师菲尔德斯通喝了一些，然后看到一只巨大的核子可乐瓶追着她跑。

EN: You wouldn't happen to have any left, would you?  We'd pay handsomely...
ZH: 你不会刚好还有剩的吧？我们会付给你丰厚的报酬……

EN: Apparently there's more to this story than meets the taste buds. This refreshing miracle beverage isn't so miraculous or refreshing after all, and the folks at the RobCo plant just may know the truth...
ZH: 显然这个故事并不只是满足味蕾。这令人耳目一新的神奇饮料也许并不是那么神奇或清新。而罗伯科工厂里的人或许知道真相……

EN: Half Full, Half Empty
ZH: 半满，半空

EN: Meet the people at the old RobCo plant.
ZH: 和罗伯科老工厂里的人们见个面。

EN: Find more info about the magical water at the old RobCo plant.
ZH: 在旧罗伯科工厂找到更多关于神奇水的信息。

EN: I think they headed to the Wilson Atomatoys Factory. Good luck!
ZH: 我觉得他们好像去威尔逊原子玩具厂了。祝好运！

EN: You looking for those Brotherhood soldiers?
ZH: 你们在找那些兄弟会的士兵吗？

EN: Yeah! Do you know where they went?
ZH: 是的！你知道他们去哪里了吗？

EN: You found the holotape records of Maxson's Roughnecks, a Brotherhood of Steel team searching the Wasteland for technology. Track them down to discover their fate - starting at Vault 450!
ZH: 你发现了“麦克森硬汉小队”的全息磁带记录，这是钢铁兄弟会派去废土搜寻科技的小队。去追踪他们、查明他们的结局吧——就从450号避难所开始！

EN: Have Gun, Will Travel
ZH: 拿起枪，我们走！

EN: Explore Vault 450.
ZH: 探索450号避难所。

EN: Discover the fate of Maxson's Roughnecks.
ZH: 揭开“麦克森硬汉小队”的命运。

EN: For Mr. Manager!
ZH: 为了经理大人！

EN: For storytime!
ZH: 为了睡前故事！

EN: Apparently there's someone with some administrative skill who was kidnapped by raiders. Let's get him out of there, and maybe in return he'll help us run our motel!
ZH: 显然有个有管理才能的人被掠夺者绑架了。让我们把他从那里救出来，也许作为回报他会帮我们经营旅馆！

EN: Headhunting
ZH: 猎头行动

EN: Rescue Mr. Manager
ZH: 拯救经理先生。

EN: Rescue a manager from a group of raiders.
ZH: 从一群掠夺者手中拯救一名经理。

EN: Aren't you a little far from home, Vaultie?
ZH: 避难所来的小家伙，离家挺远吧？

EN: You must mean Mr. Manager. He's staying with us! He tells us stories! And now you die!
ZH: 你说的一定是经理大人。他现在和我们在一起！他给我们讲故事！而你们，去死吧！

EN: We'll die before we give up Mr. Manager! He tells us stories!
ZH: 我们宁死也不放经理大人！他给我们讲故事！

EN: Manage? So you're here for Mr. Manager. You will never take him away! He tells us stories!
ZH: 管理？所以你是来找经理大人的。你休想带走他！他给我们讲故事！

EN: We're looking for a manager.
ZH: 我们在找一名经理。

EN: You have a hostage, we have a ransom.
ZH: 你们手里有人质，我们有赎金。

EN: Would you like to manage a hotel?
ZH: 想不想去经营一家旅馆？

EN: Hey, you're not from the group. What are you doing here?
ZH: 嘿，你不是这伙人的。你来干什么？

EN: Aren't you a little short for a vault dweller? Whatever, I'm done with bedtime stories.
ZH: 和一个避难所居民比起来你也太矮了吧？算了，我受够睡前故事了。
